'''International relations'''
*[[Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and [[Mauritius]] jointly announce that a deal has been made to resolve the dispute over the [[Chagos Archipelago]], with sovereignty of the [[British Indian Ocean Territory]] being handed over to Mauritius in exchange for the United Kingdom and the [[United States]] retaining control of the [[military base]] on [[Diego Garcia]] for the next 99 years. ***The [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[Parliament of Georgia|Parliament]] [[Shalva Papuashvili|Speaker]] signs into law a wide-ranging bill that bans [[Gender transition|gender transitioning]] and [[Transgender health care|gender-affirming care]], [[Same-sex marriage|same-sex marriage]] and [[Same-sex adoption|adoption]], and depictions of [[LGBTQ|LGBTQ+ people]] in media after the [[Salome Zourabichvili|President]] refused to sign it, which chief [[European Union]] diplomat [[Josep Borrell]] states could prevent the nation's [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union|accession to the EU]].
